snippet.title: BOOST VECTOR EX | Official Announcement Teaser
snippet.description:
Run fast. Faster than any other.
WISHLIST HERE! ❗ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3832030

OR HERE! ❗ https://store.epicgames.com/p/boost-vector-ex-1bb8f0

Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour anime racing. Hone your style with responsive flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

Boost Vector Ex is Blockage's seventh major game, being a spiritual (not so spiritual) sequel to Boost Vector. Solo developed by me (asmanwoks) this time around! Jump on our Discord to see updates n all that goody goody :D

https://discord.gg/AEzBEZ3
